Barleywood Kitchens is a kitchen design, supply and installation company based in Cheddar, Somerset, operating locally across Bristol, Bath and the Southwest. Offering a range of kitchens, utility rooms and appliances, as well as fitted bedroom furniture. From classic, timeless kitchens to sleek, modern spaces, they offer a complete service from initial design, through to supply and professional installation. They are also an approved supplier of the Laura Ashley fitted furniture collection.

Established in 2011, Inspired Worx are a Cheddar-based construction and renovation company, providing full domestic and commercial building services across the Southwest. With extensive expertise in structural reconfigurations, new builds, full refurbishments, reconfigurations, extensions to structural works, listed building renovations and loft conversions, the team provides a complete turnkey service from initial planning and design through to construction and completion.

desc:
Planning a one-off home? English Brothers helps self-builders turn individual ideas into bespoke timber-frame homes designed around their plot, lifestyle and budget.

From early design and planning support through to a fully weatherproof structure, our experienced team provides practical guidance, clear communication and dependable technical expertise. Every frame is tailored to the project, combining modern design technology, energy-efficient construction and skilled in-house craftsmanship.

Our roots in timber date back to 1844, but our focus is firmly on making today’s self-build journey clearer and more manageable. Visit us at the Show to discuss your plans, ask the difficult questions and discover what is possible, whether you are exploring your options or already have planning permission.

desc:
Hide My Bin (The Bin Box LTD)

Handcrafted Timber Garden Structures & Premium Outdoor Storage

Welcome to Hide My Bin!

Handcrafted right here in Somerset, we design and manufacture premium timber garden structures and outdoor storage solutions built to transform your home’s exterior. Whether you are embarking on a complete self-build, upgrading your landscaping, or simply looking to banish unsightly kerbside clutter, our handcrafted products blend heavy-duty durability with timeless architectural style.

🌟 Featured Highlight: The Award-Nominated Hexagonal 'Gondola Pod'

Rethink your garden seating and outdoor dining.

  • Shortlisted for the prestigious New Product Award at Glee 2026 and finishing a very close 2nd place, our Hexagonal Gondola Pod is an award-recognised 6-8 seater wooden garden pod engineered to create a striking focal point in any home garden or outdoor living space.
  • Award-Nominated Design: Recognised by industry judges at Glee 2026 as one of the top new garden products of the year.
  • Unique 6-Sided Geometry: Designed specifically to foster face-to-face socialising, complete with two comfortable integrated benches on opposite sides of a central 6ft dining table.
  • Architectural Low-Pitch Canopy: Features a sleek low-pitch roof lined with high-grade breathable membrane and overlapping external feather boards to ensure total weatherproofing without overpowering your garden landscape.
  • Built to Last: Constructed from C24 graded timber framing and Scandinavian decking boards, engineered for heavy year-round use.
  • Minimal Visible Fixings: Carefully crafted using high-gauge galvanised fixings placed discreetly for a clean, premium internal finish.
  • Bespoke Options: Customise your build with full rear privacy panels, integrated low-voltage or solar festoon lighting or our lates edition of 5" Castors (Only suitable on solid ground).
  • Hassle-Free Delivery & Build Included: Delivered directly to your home and professionally assembled by our team in just 2 to 4 hours (including base levelling on uneven ground).

Premium Wheelie Bin & Recycling Storage Solutions

Transform your driveway or entrance from messy to magnificent. Our range of wheelie bin and recycling box stores conceals essential household refuse while adding structural beauty to your garden.

100% British Craftsmanship: Handcrafted in Cheddar using locally sourced, FSC-certified pressure-treated timber with an expected outdoor life of 10+ years.

Seamless Convenience: Features hinged tops with auto-lift lid chains so your bin opens simultaneously with the store lid, keeping your hands clean.

Versatile Configurations: Choose from single, double, triple, or quad stores, as well as combination units housing both wheelie bins and multi-tiered recycling boxes.

Optional Green Roof Planters: Integrate living flora into your storage structure with custom removable planter tops.

Why Choose Hide My Bin for Your Home Renovation Project?

Delivered Fully Assembled: No flat-pack headaches—our storage products arrive fully built straight to your garden.
Other Matching Product: We also offer wooden garden planters, parcel boxes and other bespoke storage items to match our other products.

Visit Us at The Bath & West Showground

Come see the award-nominated Gondola Pod and our storage range in person this November!

Talk to our founder and team about custom sizing, delivery options, and how we can help complete your dream outdoor space.

Gondola Pod: Displayed Outside next to Catering & Seating Area's

Talk to us: Inside: Stand 432 - Along the back wall, diagonally opposite the main entrance.
